scene_description: Wooden shelf top with curved wooden end panels against a gray wall. The two green boxes are stacked near the middle of the shelf, the upper one upside down. The white box top and the upside-down white box sit side by side on top of the stack. Front is the open edge of the shelf.

targets.name: white box top
targets.description: White box top with blue handwritten 'HERBARIUM MICHAUX' on its front face, on the left half of the green box stack, directly beside the white box.
targets.orientation: lying flat, closed top facing up
nearby_obstacles: White box touching its right side
targets.clearance_notes: Front, back and left edges are exposed; it overhangs the left edge of the stack slightly.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the white box off the stack to open up the right side of the box top.

targets.other_notes: Raised about 8 cm on the stacked green boxes.

targets.name: white box
targets.description: White box turned upside down on the right half of the green box stack, directly beside the white box top.
targets.orientation: upside down, open side facing down
nearby_obstacles: White box top touching the lower part of its left side
targets.clearance_notes: Top, front, back and right side are exposed; its sides rise well above the box top.
targets.other_notes: Overhangs the right edge of the stack slightly.

targets.name: upper green box
targets.description: Darker green cloth-covered box with '623-683' written on its front, upside down on top of the lower green box and supporting both white objects.
targets.orientation: upside down, closed bottom facing up
nearby_obstacles: White box top resting on it
targets.clearance_notes: Front and side walls are exposed, but its top is fully covered by the two white objects.

candidate_improvements.description: Lift the white box top and white box off the stack onto clear shelf space.

targets.name: lower green box
targets.description: Lighter green cloth-covered box at the bottom of the stack, resting directly on the shelf under the upper green box.
nearby_obstacles: Upper green box and both white objects stacked on top of it
targets.clearance_notes: Only its 4 cm side walls are exposed; everything else in the scene rests on it.

candidate_improvements.description: Remove the white objects, then lift the upper green box off the stack.

source: Staged permutation of S0013 and S0015, using the same objects in a different arrangement.
